paragraphs: In [Sukkah 48b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.48b.5-6) there are two sectarians, one named Sasson and the other Simcha, in R' Abbahu’s time; see there.[^1]

notes.text: The first story names the two sectarians and plays on the names Sasson and Simcha in biblical verses. The following story has a sectarian named Sasson speaking to Rabbi Abbahu. It is this adjacent story that supplies the setting for Hyman’s reference to Abbahu.
